name: TrainPost
_intent: Karate makiwara practice from a left front stance, seen in profile: the right fist chambered at the hip and the left arm out as a sight; the hips coil away, then snap through a frame ahead of the shoulders and the right reverse punch drives straight onto the post (2 frames held) while the left fist is pulled back to the hip; it recoils and becomes the sight; then the same for a left lead punch.
_reference: makiwara training: gyaku-zuki and kizami-zuki with hikite; Hit at frames 15 and 45 (1.000 s apart)
